title: Shawn C. Martinbrough
description: The sadistic droid from Jabba's torture chamber prepares for new nastiness as a pig-guard looks on. "When I was younger and collected all those figures that Kenner Toys put out," recalls Shawn C. Martinbrough, "this particular scene stuck in my head from the RETURN OF THE JEDI collection commercial." After a lengthy study at the Children's Art carnival in Harlem, Martinbrough went on to illustrate a short story in CLIVE BARKER'S HELLRAISER series along with several illos for Marvel Comics' Epic division. When not working on various film scripts and proposals, Shawn, age 22, tries to relax at home and not take life too seriously.
